payload.title: Automations slice 2: enabled, limits, cost and run now (M)
payload.description:
Slice 2 of automations, after slice 1 (PPY-2e6e2b, Papyrus #630). Makes the record real for monitor automations, with Distinctive's distinctive.ttab as the test site.

Scope:
- enabled: the monitoring router reads the automation record before starting a procedure; a disabled automation starts nothing and records 'skipped: automation disabled'. With no record, or an unreadable one, the router behaves exactly as before (procedureTriggers stays authoritative).
- Limits: timeoutSeconds goes to the runner's deadline (capped at the Lambda's limit); maxConcurrent refuses a new start with a recorded reason; budgetUsdPerRun stays advisory, compared with the recorded cost and flagged.
- Cost: procedure_runner_child reports token use per call; run_procedure_request stores the usage and an estimated cost (price table in data, GPT-6 Luna) on the ProcedureRun. Shown in 'papyrus automations runs' and the console.
- Run now: 'papyrus automations run --id X [--input JSON]' and a console button (editors, admins, confirm step). Invokes the runner and links the run to the automation's history.
- History also lists the procedure's other ProcedureRuns under 'Started outside this automation'.
- automationOverview admits the operator IAM roles for reading; writes stay editor or admin.

Not in scope: schedule and event triggers, queueing, deploys (the release and the router deploy are separate).

Acceptance: Gherkin specs (narrative, complete), unit tests for every behaviour including the router's disabled, fallback and maxConcurrent paths, and TS tests for the console.
